entities.name: Ethyl 2-(3-furan-2-ylphenoxy)acetate
observations: SELFIES substrate decodes to ethyl 2-{[3-(furan-2-yl)phenyl]oxy}acetate; canonical SMILES CCOC(=O)COc1cccc(-c2ccco2)c1.

entities.name: Ester saponification
observations: Aqueous sodium hydroxide promotes hydrolysis of the ethyl ester to the corresponding carboxylic acid after workup.
The matching record reports approximately 82% yield over 4 hours in water; chloride is a spectator ion.

entities.name: 2-(3-furan-2-ylphenoxy)acetic acid
observations: Predicted isolated product after acidic workup; SMILES O=C(O)COc1cccc(-c2ccco2)c1.
Under the unacidified basic reaction mixture, the corresponding carboxylate O=C([O-])COc1cccc(-c2ccco2)c1 is the predominant species.
